title: Sonny White's Casimir-effect chip

tellings.quote:
Yeah, you have Sunny
White with who can engineer the Casemir
effect

plain: The engineer Harold "Sonny" White can engineer the Casimir effect, Michels says, meaning the tiny force that empty space exerts between surfaces placed extremely close together, reportedly harnessed on a chip. Michels mentions it in passing as his own point, offering White as someone already working with exotic physics of the kind tied to advanced propulsion.
